newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Optics sees '97 loss, has 2 orders.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Optics sees '97 loss, has 2 orders.

text.p: Advanced Optics Electronics Inc said on Tuesday that projected revenue should result in a loss for 1997 but the company added that two pending orders have been placed.
The company said it projects revenues of $755,000 this year, adding this should result in a loss for the year of about $0.02 per share which would compare to a 1996 loss of $0.14 per share.
Advanced Optics Electronics Inc said Tuesday it has two pending orders of $850,000 each for large scale flat panel displays, noting this response has been without any formal marketing effort.
Advanced Optics also said it estimates 1998 earnings of $0.21 to $0.23 per share on revenues of nearly $5 million and 1999 earnings of $0.85 to $0.95 per share on revenues of $15.6 million.
The company is involved in the manufacture of electro-optic systems and holds patents and patents pending on its unique technology for flat panel displays.
The company said its panel displays exhibit a high degree of brightness and high speed ability to change color images.

It said Gannett Co Inc "has expressed strong interest in the company's (billboard) technology, specifically in the replacement of up to 10 percent of their locations with the installation of the company's systems."
Advanced Optics noted Gannett has 36,000 bilboards.

The company said it has produced large scale flat panel displays -- billboards -- at a cost of 10 percent of a comparable system due to its patented process that produces substantially larger amounts of pixels per square inch than competing technologies.
